command-composition.title: Combine prepared command files
command-composition.intro: Reference existing files on the target machine and create one new command configuration. File contents stay on that machine.
command-composition.output: New JSON output file · absolute path
command-composition.limits: 2–16 existing files. The native tool checks source files, duplicate command IDs and cross-file references; it never overwrites the output.
command-composition.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select the command preview to copy it manually.
command-composition.next: Run the command explicitly on the target machine, then use the new output path in the original Runner inspection, registration and enablement flow.
command-composition.use_hint: This adopts only the path. Run the composition command on the machine first, then inspect, register and enable through the original flow.
command-composition.boundary: Copying does not run the command. Composition does not grant inventory or dispatch permission. Internal checks are separate from same-commit testing on an independent Worker.
command-composition.issue.source_path: Use an absolute source file path without control characters or path aliases.
command-composition.issue.duplicate_sour: Source file {{number}} repeats an earlier reference. Choose a different file.
command-composition.issue.output_path: Use a new absolute file path ending in .json, without control characters or path aliases.
command-composition.issue.output_source: The output must be a new file, separate from every source reference.
command-composition.issue.too_large: These references exceed the native 64 KiB input limit. Shorten the paths or reduce the number of files.
